input.text: South of the Rise, the ground keeps its shape for a while, then stops asking you to believe in it. Some who walked that far came back saying the light thinned to something that wasn't quite dusk. None have come back saying what was past that.

items.text: Answered Archos's prayer about what lies south of the world's edge with an in-world, mysterious reply rather than silence or a mechanical answer.
